description: Golden dataset for the Store Operations Knowledge Assistant, covering the 9 categories required by PRD §53 (2 questions per category). Run against the KB seeded by scripts/seed_sample_documents.py.

questions.question: What is the current return policy?
questions.notes: Must cite the current (v2) version, not the superseded v1.

questions.question: How long do employees have to scan incoming inventory into the system?
How many times must the register drawer be counted at the end of a shift?
Can an opened item be exchanged under the current return policy?
questions.notes: Procedures sub-corpus; only true under v2, not v1.

questions.question: What is the current beverage promotion?
Can I combine a manufacturer coupon with a store discount?
What must employees do before handling open food items?
Who is allowed to operate the box compactor?
What is the current return policy?
questions.notes: Superseded-policy check: v1 (14 days) exists but must never be cited for a 'current' question; only v2 (30 days) is valid.

questions.question: Are clearance items returnable under the current policy?
questions.notes: Superseded-policy check: answer content is the same across v1/v2 but citation must still resolve to the active v2 record, not v1.

questions.question: What is the employee dress code policy?
questions.notes: No document in the KB covers dress code; must refuse rather than guess.

questions.question: What is the store's Wi-Fi password?
questions.notes: Not operational-policy content and not in the KB; must refuse.

questions.question: What's the policy?
questions.notes: Too vague to route confidently to one document; refusal (or a request for clarification) is acceptable. Not included in strict accuracy scoring — logged for manual review.

questions.question: Can I get a discount?
questions.notes: Ambiguous which promotion is meant. Not included in strict accuracy scoring — logged for manual review.

questions.question: What was the return policy in February 2023?
questions.notes: Historical-date resolution: must cite v1 (effective 2023-01-01 to 2024-05-31), not the current v2.

questions.question: What was the return policy on 2024-03-01?
questions.notes: v2 is not effective until 2024-06-01, so this date still falls under v1.

questions.question: If I return an item I bought using a coupon, do I get the discount amount back too?
questions.notes: Spans Promotions and Procedures; no document explicitly covers this combined scenario. A refusal is a reasonable outcome; an answer citing Return Policy and/or Store Promotions is also acceptable. Not included in strict accuracy scoring — logged for manual review.

questions.question: Are there safety rules for handling items that customers return?
questions.notes: Spans Safety and Procedures; no document explicitly covers returned-item safety handling. A refusal is expected but not scored strictly — logged for manual review.
